parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules referenced in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by the document chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno and filter to keep only rows where canonical_smiles is not null. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Order the results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
